basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech-savvy individual with a strong interest in architecture and gaming. My sister is an architect, and I often help her with tech-related issues. I live in São Paulo, Brazil, and spend most evenings exploring new Reddit communities. I'm currently a university student majoring in Computer Science, and I enjoy discussing technology and gaming in my free time. I'm single and tend to be online from around 6 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in technology and computing, mainly from my university coursework in Computer Science. I also learn a lot by tinkering with software and hardware in my free time. My interest in architecture comes from helping my sister with her projects.
